doc: Credentials for the Report Design System skill. Deliberately MINIMAL — only what is known to be needed, nothing invented.
This manifest is the per-domain model's proof: a design operator is checked on Figma and never on PostHog, Slack, Linear or AWS, none of which this domain touches.

credentials.how: Interactive OAuth for the Figma MCP in Claude Code (project-scoped). The design source of truth — reading a file's variables, components and screenshots goes through it, and there is no CLI fallback
Interactive OAuth for the GitHub MCP in Claude Code (project-scoped). Used to read the component code a design maps onto; not required to compose a page
